visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A brown cardboard box is being opened on a speckled tile floor by a person whose hands are partially visible. Inside the box, a cluster of yellow-capped bottles wrapped in bubble wrap is revealed. Numerous small, brownish worm-like insects are seen crawling on the box flaps and the floor around the package. (2) The person lifts the bubble-wrapped items from the box, revealing even more insects scattered across the tiles and the plastic surface. A fine mist is sprayed repeatedly over the scene, targeting the moving insects. The background shows a simple indoor setting with a white wall and the edge of a potted plant. (3) The camera moves closer to the floor, capturing the insects crawling frantically. The person continues to spray the area, while more insects emerge from the crevices of the packaging. The lighting is bright and overhead, casting sharp shadows on the floor. (4) The person begins to unpack individual plastic pouches from the bubble wrap, which are various colors like green and red. As each pouch is moved, more insects are shaken loose. The floor becomes cluttered with pouches and insects, some of which have stopped moving after being sprayed. (5) A final overview shows the scattered contents of the package, including drink pouches and health supplement packets, surrounded by dozens of insects. The camera pans across the scene, documenting the scale of the infestation on the floor before settling on a close-up of the dead insects.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) The audio begins with a mix of female and male voices speaking in shocked tones. A rhythmic, rapid 'shutter-click' sound effect is introduced and persists throughout. The rustling of a cardboard box and bubble wrap creates a low-frequency textural background. (2) As the items are removed, a high-frequency percussive sound, possibly representing an alcohol spray, repeats in sync with the clicking SFX. The male speaker's pitch rises as he describes the number of insects. (3) The clicking SFX remains steady, creating a sense of urgency. The female speaker asks a question with rising intonation, and the male response is enunciated clearly with a narrative, slightly professional yet strained tone. (4) The sounds of plastic pouches falling onto the hard floor produce distinct 'thud' impacts. The background environment is otherwise quiet, characteristic of an indoor studio or home setting with minimal room tone. (5) In the final phase, the voices transition to a calmer, explanatory dialogue. The clicking sound persists at a slightly lower volume, while the male speaker explains the physiological effect of alcohol on the insects, ending the track on an informative note.

narrative_and_purpose.narrativeStructure: Linear: Hook -> Crisis -> Action -> Technical Explanation
narrative_and_purpose.mainPurpose: To document and share a shocking experience of finding an insect infestation inside a newly arrived online package, and to show the use of alcohol as an emergency pest control measure.
